mention_posts.author: pilates.by.cat
mention_posts.text:
Save this for a full body sculpt ✨

I’ve been teaching Pilates for 20 years, and when I’m short on time, this is one of my favourite full-body workouts. In just 15 minutes, you can strengthen your core, sculpt your glutes, tone your upper body and improve your posture.

The best part? You don’t need any equipment. This entire workout can be done next to your bed using just your body weight. If you have ankle weights or hand weights, feel free to add them for an extra challenge, but they’re completely optional.

✨ Elbows to Plank ×10
✨ Arm Leg Scissors ×10
✨ Straight Leg Sweeps ×10
✨ Oblique Crunch ×10
✨ Double Arm Stretch ×10

Complete 3 rounds 🤍

This is one of those workouts that leaves your whole body feeling stronger, longer and more connected from head to toe.

Save this workout for later and follow for Pilates that actually works. 🤍

#Pilates #FullBodyWorkout #PilatesWorkout #HomeWorkout #BodySculpt
